description: Audience presets bundle threshold defaults for different reporting personas. Selecting a preset overlays its values onto the current configuration. Individual fields can still be tuned afterward.

presets.name: Executive
presets.description: Sparser layouts, tighter visual budgets, conservative cognitive load thresholds.

presets.name: Operational
presets.description: Balanced defaults for day-to-day operational reports.

presets.name: Analyst
presets.description: Looser thresholds for analyst-focused exploration views with richer drill-down density.
